description: A membership isomorphism between transitive sets fixes every element.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.transitive_iso_identity.{u} (T U : ZFSet.{u}) (hT : T.IsTransitive)
  (hU : U.IsTransitive) (e : ↥T ≃ ↥U) (he : ∀ (a b : ↥T), ↑a ∈ ↑b ↔ ↑(e a) ∈ ↑(e b)) : T = U ∧ ∀ (a : ↥T), ↑(e a) = ↑a
